plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Gerald Mohr is credited on 255 distinct recordings across 26 programs from 1938-11-01 through 1955-11-11. Documented roles include performer on 219 recordings and announcer on 43 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are The Adventures of Philip Marlowe (performer on 85 recordings; 85 distinct recordings), Fu Manchu (announcer on 43 recordings and performer on 7 recordings; 43 distinct recordings), The Whistler (performer on 39 recordings; 39 distinct recordings), Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 13 recordings; 13 distinct recordings), Dr. Christian (performer on 10 recordings; 10 distinct recordings), Rogues Gallery (performer on 8 recordings; 8 distinct recordings), Screen Directors Playhouse (performer on 7 recordings; 7 distinct recordings), and The Phil Harris-Alice Faye Show (performer on 6 recordings; 6 distinct recordings).

Documented character portrayals include Philip Marlowe (85 portrayals), Archie Goodwin (4 portrayals), and Johnny Dollar (1 portrayals).
